summary: Table of legacy special module default groups: aws, azure, gcp, k8s, os, acme and their extended collection groups.
questions: What built-in module_defaults groups exist for cloud providers?
Which collections does the k8s module_defaults group cover?

answer_card.title: Special module defaults groups (part 1)
answer_card.answer_md:
| Group | Extended group |
|---|---|
| aws | amazon.aws.aws, community.aws.aws |
| azure | azure.azcollection.azure |
| gcp | google.cloud.gcp |
| k8s | community.kubernetes.k8s, community.general.k8s, community.kubevirt.k8s, community.okd.k8s, kubernetes.core.k8s |
| os | openstack.cloud.os |
| acme | community.crypto.acme |
